column1: # character | meaning | parts (radicals or earlier kanji, comma-separated; "-" for a pictograph) | picture story
# Readings, stroke counts and JLPT level come from KANJIDIC2; strokes from KanjiVG.
# Keep each part's meaning word inside the story so the app can highlight it.
@stage 2
日|sun, day|日|You already know this brick: the sun, and the day it lights.
月|moon, month|月|The moon you met as a brick. One cycle of it is a month.
木|tree|木|The tree brick, now standing on its own.
火|fire|火|Fire on its own: flames with sparks flying out.
水|water|水|Water on its own, splashing from the central stream.
土|soil|土|Soil on its own: a sprout pushing out of the ground.
金|gold, money|-|Nuggets of gold buried deep under a roof of rock. Gold means money.
一|one|一|One line, one thing.
二|two|二|Two lines, two things.
三|three|一,二|One line on top of two lines makes three.
人|person|人|A person walking: you know this one.
口|mouth|口|The open mouth, now a word of its own.
山|mountain|山|Three peaks: the mountain.
川|river|川|Three streams flowing side by side: the river.
田|rice field|田|The rice field with its four plots.
子|child|子|The child in a blanket, arms out.
女|woman|女|The kneeling woman, now a word.
大|big|大|A person stretching wide: big.
小|small|小|A small stick shedding crumbs.
中|middle|口,丨|A stick pierces the mouth right through the middle.
上|up, above|卜,一|A wand points up from the ground line: above.
下|down, below|一,卜|A wand hangs down below the line: below.
十|ten|十|The cross: ten.
八|eight|八|Two strokes split apart: eight.
四|four|囗,儿|Little legs trapped inside an enclosure with four walls: four.
五|five|-|Two bars with a zigzag post between them: five.
六|six|亠,八|A lid resting on legs that split apart: a table for six.
七|seven|-|A cross whose tail hooks to the right: seven.
九|nine|丿,乙|A slash tangled with a hook makes nine.
百|hundred|一,日|One sun shines on a hundred days.
千|thousand|丿,十|A slash on top of ten pushes it up to a thousand.
万|ten thousand|-|Banners flying from one pole by the ten thousand.
円|yen, circle|-|A round yen coin standing in its frame.
目|eye|目|The eye, turned on its side.
耳|ear|耳|The ear with all its folds.
手|hand|手|The hand with its fingers spread.
足|foot, leg|口,止|A kneecap like a mouth above a foot that will not stop: the leg.
本|book, origin|木,一|A line marks the root of the tree: the origin. Bound pages from a tree make a book.
休|rest|亻,木|A tired person leans on a tree to rest.
好|to like|女,子|A woman holding her child: what she likes most.
明|bright|日,月|The sun and the moon together: so bright.
林|woods|木,木|Two trees side by side make the woods.
森|forest|木,木,木|Three trees crowd together into a forest.
体|body|亻,本|A person and their origin together: the body.
男|man|田,力|Power in the rice field: the man who works it.
父|father|-|Two crossed tools that father carries home.
母|mother|-|A mother cradling her baby, two drops of milk.
友|friend|-|Two hands reaching out to each other: a friend.
左|left|工|The left hand holds the craft tool steady.
右|right|口|The right hand lifts food to the mouth.
今|now|人|A person ducking under a roof right now.
何|what|亻,口|A person with an open mouth asks: what?
年|year|-|A farmer shoulders the rice at the end of the year.
時|time|日,土,寸|The sun crosses the soil, measured by hand: time.
間|interval|門,日|The sun peeks through a gate: the space between, an interval.
分|minute, part|八,刀|A sword splits it apart: a part, a minute.
半|half|-|A cross cut straight down the middle: half.
前|before, front|-|A boat moored in front of the dock, before it sails.
後|after, behind|彳|Steps trailing behind: after.
午|noon|-|A pestle standing straight up at noon.
毎|every|-|A mother in her hat, every single day.
週|week|⻌,口|Along the road, mouths to feed all week.
曜|weekday|日|The sun with a bird's wings flaps through each weekday.
生|life, birth|-|A sprout bursting out of the soil: life.
先|ahead|儿|Legs running on ahead of everyone.
学|study|子|A child under the schoolhouse roof, there to study.
校|school|木|Wooden halls where students mix: school.
名|name|夕,口|In the evening dark you call out a name with your mouth.
白|white|日|A drop of light on the sun: pure white.
気|spirit, air|-|Steam rising from rice: spirit in the air.
天|heaven|一,大|One line above a big person: heaven.
雨|rain|雨|Rain from a cloud: you know this one.
電|electricity|雨|Rain and a bolt of lightning: electricity.
車|car|-|A cart seen from above: axle and two wheels. A car.
東|east|木,日|The sun rising behind a tree: east.
西|west|-|A bird settling into its nest as the sun sets in the west.
南|south|十|A cross on a warm tent to the south.
北|north|-|Two people sitting back to back, one facing north.
国|country|囗|A jewel kept inside an enclosure: the country.
外|outside|夕,卜|In the evening a wand is read outside.
店|shop|广,卜,口|A building where a wand points to a mouth: a shop.
駅|station|馬|Where horses stopped to rest: the station.
道|road, way|⻌|Heading down the road: the way.
会|meet|人|People under one roof meet.
社|company, shrine|礻,土|An altar on the soil: a shrine, and the company that gathers there.
行|go|彳|Step after step down the street: go.
来|come|米|A stalk heavy with rice: harvest time has come.
見|see|目,儿|An eye on legs walking off to see.
聞|hear|門,耳|An ear pressed to the gate to hear.
言|say|言|Words tumbling out of a mouth: say.
話|talk|言,口|Speech and a busy mouth: talk.
語|language|言,五,口|Speech from five mouths: a language.
読|read|言|Speech you sell out loud: read.
書|write|日|A brush held over the sunlit page to write.
食|eat|食|The lid over the bowl: eat.
飲|drink|食,欠|Eat with a yawning open mouth: drink.
買|buy|貝|A net catching shells, the old money: buy.
入|enter|-|Two lines meeting at a doorway: enter.
出|exit|山|A mountain climbing out of its box: exit.
立|stand|立|A person standing firm on the ground.
高|tall, expensive|口|A tall tower with a mouth-like window. Tall things are expensive.
長|long|-|An old man with long hair blowing in the wind.
新|new|立,木,斤|Stand a tree up, swing the axe: something new.
古|old|十,口|Ten mouths have passed it down: old.
安|cheap, safe|宀,女|A woman under a roof is safe. Safe deals are cheap.
多|many|夕,夕|Evening after evening: many.
少|few, a little|小|Small, with one slash more: a little.
早|early|日,十|The sun over a cross, rising early.
花|flower|艹,亻|Grass that turns into a person's delight: a flower.
空|sky, empty|宀,八,工|A roof split open above the craftsman: the empty sky.
魚|fish|田|A fish with a scaly rice-field middle and tail fins.
@stage 3
住|live|亻|A person who is master of the house: to live there.
作|make|亻|A person busily cutting and shaping: make.
使|use|亻|A person sent as an official, put to use.
持|hold|扌,土,寸|A hand grips the soil and measures it: hold.
待|wait|彳,土,寸|Steps to the temple soil, measured: wait there.
家|house|宀|A pig snug under a roof: the house.
町|town|田|Rice fields with a nail-straight street: a town.
村|village|木,寸|Trees measured out by hand: a village.
歩|walk|止,少|Stop, then a little more: walk.
走|run|土|Legs flying over the soil: run.
朝|morning|十,日,月|The sun between the grass while the moon is still out: morning.
夜|night|亠,亻,夕|Under a lid, a person in the evening: night.
昼|daytime, noon|日|The sun just over the horizon line: daytime.
夕|evening|夕|The moon just rising: evening.
犬|dog|大,丶|A big creature with a drop at its ear: a dog.
茶|tea|艹,木|Grass and a tree: the leaves of tea.
肉|meat|-|A slab of meat with its marbling.
色|color|-|A person kneeling over another: the color in their cheeks.
赤|red|土|Soil glowing red over the fire.
青|blue|月|A sprout over the moon: blue-green.
近|near|斤,⻌|An axe left on the road nearby: near.
遠|far|⻌|A long robe trailing down a road that goes far.
乗|ride|千,木|A thousand people riding high in a tree: ride.
降|descend, fall|-|Feet stepping down the hill: descend. Rain falls the same way.
帰|return|-|Sweeping the house with a broom when you return.
洗|wash|氵,先|Water running ahead of you: wash.
料|fee, materials|米|Rice measured with a ladle: materials, and the fee.
真|true|十,目|Ten eyes confirm it: true.
写|copy|冖|A cover laid over a page to copy it.
音|sound|立,日|Standing in the sun, humming a sound.
楽|fun, music|木|Music played on a wooden instrument: fun.
紙|paper|糸|Threads pressed flat into paper.
